title: Battelle Brainstorms injectable interface

tellings.quote: According to Battelle's own 2020 press release, their team progressed to phase two of the program.

plain: A research organisation called Battelle worked on a program it called Brainstorms, an interface that could be injected into the body to link the brain with machines, alongside the Air Force Research Lab and Carnegie Mellon University. Michels tells this himself and points to Battelle's own 2020 press release, which he says announced that the team had "progressed to phase two of the program". He brings it up to show how far military-backed brain technology had gone.
